sources_read.section: the rung-1 function to parametrise with a page

scope: A page on ImportCandidate, the pdf-text-boxes helper, the rung-1 scan of the open document through the pdf seam, the per-candidate review, and the mount. Out of scope: uploading or creating an artifact (D-02), rungs 2/3, OCR.

acceptance_criteria.text: ImportReview writes each candidate with its own page (slug, bbox, reading order).
A pdfjs text item maps to a display-space box through the viewport transform (compose matrices).
The scan loads the session's main artifact bytes, opens it, and returns per-page rung-1 candidates; a missing artifact says why.
Tests cover the box mapping, the scan, and the per-page review.

open_questions: D-02 (defaulted: the import is the uploaded note-slot copy) — this task imports the OPEN document's own annotations instead, because Lite has no artifact-upload flow; geometry is therefore correct. The note-slot upload remains a follow-up. Raised, not silently re-decided.
RULE-19 (standing): rung 1 only — a real annotation is exact, so no OCR runs.
D-03 (defaulted): the import writes group highlights; the leader is the caller (RLS backs it).
risks: A multi-page scan must carry each candidate's page or the slug/bbox would be computed against page 0.
Re-scanning the same PDF could duplicate marks; the review requires acceptance and the slug is deterministic, so a re-import dedupes at the Result level.
pdfjs needs the bytes; the container reads OPFS/Storage through the existing seam and reports a load failure.
